title: HIP host infrastructure (stream pool, allocator, multi-arch dispatch)
description:
## Goal

Stand up the HIP host infrastructure: stream pool, allocator
wrappers, deterministic-launch helpers, and multi-arch dispatch
shim. gfx1030 is the only CI target today; gfx1100 / gfx1200 /
MI series seams documented per Phase 0 design doc.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages for gf2-sim pipeline)
within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Lives split between
`gf2-kernels-hip` (FFI / kernels) and `gf2-sim` (host-side
dispatcher behind feature `hip`). Placeholder body — project-lead
expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] HIP stream pool, allocator wrappers, and
  deterministic-launch helpers compile clean under
  `--features hip` on gfx1030; multi-arch dispatch shim selects
  the gfx1030 path with `tracing::warn` fallback for other archs.

## Non-goals

Multi-GPU implementation (epic non-goals).
